summary_rationale: Microsoft passes as an elite institutional compounder on business quality, anchored by an unmatched enterprise distribution moat across identity (Entra ID), productivity (Microsoft 365), developer workflows (GitHub), and hyperscale cloud (Azure, which crossed $100B annual revenue in FY26 and accelerated to 48% YoY growth at $33.2B in Q1 FY27). Consolidated FY26 revenue reached $331,839M (+18% YoY) with 67.9% gross margin, 46.8% operating margin ($155,237M), $182,943M operating cash flow, 24.2% ROIC, and $677B in Commercial RPO (+73% YoY in Q1 FY27). KPI health is set to PASS_WITH_WATCH rather than an unqualified PASS because capital intensity has surged dramatically: FY26 capex jumped 79.6% to $115,907M (compressing FCF conversion from 84.0% of net income in FY24 to 50.1% in FY26), Q1 FY27 capex hit $45.2B with >$50B guided for Q2 FY27 and ~$170B for FY27, and rising depreciation ($38.5B in FY26) tests incremental ROIC. Secondary watches include OpenAI concentration ($6.0B accounts receivable, April 2026 multi-cloud pact loosening) and the gap between 30M+ paid Microsoft 365 Copilot seats and 30–55% enterprise weekly active usage.
